children: Global, social-first campaign gives well-known hosts the chance to be guests themselves, with locally inspired creative, new consumer research and bookable experiences
ATLANTA, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- It's time to leave "host mode" at home.
from

finds that two-thirds of travelers who often play the role of host among family and friends say organizing a trip can feel like another job, and they're ready to swap the to-do list for being taken care of.

Enter "When the Host Needs Hosting," IHG's global, social-first campaign rooted in the idea that even the best hosts deserve to be hosted. Across the United States, Mexico, Australia, Japan, the United Kingdom and Germany, the campaign features some of the world's most beloved personalities taking a break from their usual host roles to experience IHG hospitality firsthand, this time as a guest.
"At IHG, we know a lot about what it means to be a great host, and how much thought goes into making someone feel truly welcome," said
Connor Smith, Senior Vice President of Global Brands – Luxury, Lifestyle, Masterbrand and Global Creative Director

. "With a portfolio of 21 hotel brands spanning over 100 countries around the world, we have the opportunity to create meaningful experiences that make every guest feel genuinely cared for. 'When the Host Needs Hosting' is a reminder that great hospitality is about more than where you stay. It's about how you feel while you're there."

While united by a global theme, each market brings its own perspective to the campaign, drawing on local personalities, cultural insights and new research* to explore what hosting and being hosted means around the world.
United States
Kicking off in the U.S., comedian, media personality and celebrity interviewer, Amelia Dimoldenberg trades her usual role as a host for a well-earned stay offering a

at what happens when the person asking all the questions finally gets to switch off. The collaboration also inspired "Hosted Like a Host," a limited-time bookable hotel experience bringing Dimoldenberg's favorite ways to travel, unwind and indulge to select IHG hotels.
Mexico

In Mexico, television host, model and entrepreneur Montserrat Oliver brings "Viajar a la Mexicana" to life, celebrating the warmth, spontaneity and joyful spirit of Mexican travel and hospitality. Rooted in a culture where making others feel welcome and cared for comes naturally, the campaign gives Oliver a chance to experience that same hospitality herself after more than three decades of hosting.
Australia

Australians spend an estimated 478 million hours each year planning, preparing, hosting and cleaning up after get-togethers, according to new research from IHG and YouGov. In celebration of the country's everyday hosts, IHG partnered with celebrity chef and TV host Melissa Leong to turn the tables on hosting, inviting her to step out of the kitchen and into the guest suite. The campaign continues on-property with five limited-time hotel experiences inspired by Melissa Leong's own hosting style, available for IHG One Rewards members to bid on using points through Nov. 20, 2026 (or later).
Japan

In Japan, local research offers another perspective on hosting: those who regularly care for others often find joy in doing so, while also valuing opportunities to relax on their own terms. Actor and artist Dean Fujioka brings that insight to life in "When the Host Needs Hosting: Travel, Your Way," exploring two distinct stays through Hotel Indigo's connection to local neighborhoods and Kimpton's personalized approach to hospitality. IHG One Rewards members can also access behind-the-scenes footage and an interview with Fujioka about his personal travel preferences.
U.K.

In the U.K., new research from IHG and OnePoll revealed that nearly six in ten (58%) people who regularly take care of others and organize group plans find themselves carrying those responsibilities with them when they go away. TV presenter Josie Gibson puts that insight at the heart of her hotel stays, handing over the planning and embracing a trip where someone else takes care of the details. IHG One Rewards members can also bid on limited-time experiences inspired by Josie Gibson's favorite ways to travel, unwind and indulge through Dec. 28, 2026 (or later).
Germany

In Germany, host, actress and DJ Palina Rojinski explores distinctly different ways to unwind across three IHG brands, from yoga at Kimpton to drinks at Ruby Hotels' round-the-clock bar and discovering the neighborhood with Hotel Indigo. Her experiences also inspired limited-time "Hosted Like Palina" stays at select properties across Germany through Dec. 28, 2026 (or later).

Looking to be hosted like a host? In select markets, IHG One Rewards members can use points to bid on select talent-inspired hotel experiences through IHG One Rewards Access. Visit auctions.ihg.com to learn more.
* in select markets
